description: AI PESTLE Analysis — PESTLE analysis of a company, industry or market: subject= (required) plus optional region=, horizon= and context= (your own recent facts). Returns 2-4 political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental factors each with impact (opportunity/threat/mixed), magnitude, likelihood and timeframe; offline priority scores, headwind/tailwind per category, overall lean, top opportunities and threats, strategic implications, watch signals and markdown. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
